notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI has an authored ItemTextFrame shell: Program.GameObjects.cs DrawItemTextFrame draws the 384x512 window with the four-piece UI-ItemText-* art and minimize-style close button, filled with gameobject page text fetched via CMSG_PAGE_TEXT_QUERY (chained pages followed via the next-page id). CMSG_ITEM_TEXT_QUERY exists but only serves the mail frame's letter bodies. The reader lacks most of the reference furniture and the bag-letter route.
